text: For photonic computing, what is the primary value of a dissipative Kerr soliton microcomb?
choices: It performs matrix multiplication directly in the frequency domain
It provides an all-optical nonlinearity for activation functions
It stores optical bits non-volatilely between computations
It replaces a rack of individually stabilized lasers with one pump laser and one ring, supplying many exactly-spaced, phase-locked WDM channels
explanation: The microcomb is above all a component substitution: one pump laser plus one microresonator can replace a rack of stabilized lasers and supply the dozens of exactly-spaced, mutually coherent WDM carriers a tensor core consumes. It does not itself perform the matrix multiply, supply the nonlinearity, or store bits; those remain separate parts of the system.
